stem: A patient says that several times a day she feels cold for a while and then hot for a while, never both at the same time, with a bitter taste and a sense of fullness under the ribs. In the inquiry about chills and fever, how is this report classified?

options.A: chills and fever occurring simultaneously, indicating an exterior invasion
options.B: fever without chills, indicating an interior Heat pattern
options.C: alternating chills and fever, indicating a half-exterior half-interior pattern
options.D: chills without fever, indicating an interior Cold pattern
